artworks.title: Susanna im Bade (Susanna in the Bath)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts three figurative art pieces. In the center, there is a woman seated with various body parts visible. The woman appears reclined with her head tilted back. Positioned closely around her are two male figures, one directly behind her and the other to the side. The central figure's facial features are somewhat obscured. The figures are not dressed distinctly, but are sketched with shading and lines. The background consists of dense, vertical, and diagonal strokes that enhance the texture and depth of the scene.

artworks.title: Joseph und Potiphars Weib I (Joseph and Potiphar's Wife I)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures lying down. The artwork features two forms, one in the foreground appearing more prominently and the other positioned slightly above and behind. The primary figure is rendered in a reclining position with outlined contours. The artist employs dynamic and expressive lines to capture the figures, accentuating various details through hatching and cross-hatching techniques. The secondary figure is depicted extending their arms forward. The composition's lines are fluid yet intense. The use of dark and light contrasts enhances the depth of this intimate scene.

artworks.title: Der Harem (The Harem)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on J. W. Zanders laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows several figures, mostly focusing on their upper bodies. The central person is seated with their torso exposed and turned left, while another figure to the right stands next to them facing forward. The individual on the left appears to be bending over. The figures' facial features are sketched with shading, hinting at varied expressions. Their hair is illustrated with flowing strokes, giving a textured look. The clothing details are minimal, and there are no visible jewelry or objects. The background consists of abstract hatched lines, adding depth to the artwork's impressionistic style.

artworks.title: Rudolf Rittner als Florian Geyer (Rudolf Rittner as Florian Geyer)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a person crouched in a forward-leaning stance. The person is holding a sword in one hand and a large cape or fabric in the other. The facial expression appears focused, and the hair is short and combed back. The person is wearing form-fitting clothing resembling earlier European styles. The background is simple with swirling lines, and there are no additional objects or accessories present.

artworks.title: Odysseus und die Freier (Odysseus and the Suitor)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two intertwined figures. The artwork depicts two figures intertwined in a dynamic pose. The figures appear to be in motion, with one supporting the other. The style of the drawing uses thick lines to convey the musculature of the figures. The shading and line work suggest a strong light source. The background is minimal.

artworks.title: Der Ritter (The Knight)
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is an etching that depicts two individuals in a close-up view. The first person has long hair tilted to one side and their face partially covered by shadow. They wear no shirt, and stand in front of the second figure. The second figure is a male with a furrowed brow, large mustache, and wearing headgear and what appears to be armor or a cloak. Both figures are detailed and illustrated in style, with strong lines and shading against a light background. There is no color or jewelry present in the artwork, set against a plain and textured background that emphasizes the central figures.

artworks.title: Frauenraub III (Abduction III)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring abstract figures. One nude figure is shown entangled or interacting with another abstract figure. The drawing uses expressive and bold lines to depict movement or tension. The figure to the right is less defined, creating a sense of fluidity. The use of varying line intensities adds depth and contrast to the composition, conveying a dynamic and complex energy.

artworks.title: Kniender Krieger in Abwehr I (Kneeling Warrior I)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image displays a partial body sketch of a person from the knees upward, focusing on their upper body and head. The person is kneeling, with one arm raised and bent, shading their face. The facial features are expressive, showing an open mouth and wide eyes, and the sketch renders the person's hair as short. The figure is unclothed, emphasizing the natural contours of the body, and they are not wearing any visible jewelry. The background is a plain, unadorned surface. There is a feathered headpiece or helmet near the person. The artwork signature is at the bottom.

artworks.title: Kuhstall II (Cow Barn II)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on Van Gelder Zonen laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cow lying down. The drawing is rendered in a simple and minimalist style with fine lines. The cow is depicted in a relaxed, reclining position, facing to the left. The artist uses delicate line work to define the contours of the cow's body and features. The background is sparse, with just a few sketchy lines suggesting the environment around the cow. The overall effect is one of calmness and simplicity, with an emphasis on capturing the essence of the cow's form and posture.

artworks.title: Pflegerin (Nurse)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a person from the shoulders up, showcasing part of their torso and head. The individual is positioned at a slight angle, with their body somewhat turned towards the right side of the composition. Their facial features are sketched with pronounced, expressive lines, giving prominence to their large, attentive eyes and an open mouth. The hair appears to be short and somewhat tousled, drawn with quick, definitive strokes. The clothing is sketched with minimal lines, suggesting a long-sleeved garment. There is no distinct background; the image focuses solely on the person's figure, set against a plain cream-colored backdrop.

artworks.title: Krankenschwester (Nurse)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on Van Gelder Zonen laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a woman from the waist up, in profile view facing toward the right side. She appears seated, with a slightly twisted torso and head turned. The woman has a delicate facial profile with a prominent nose, subtle cheekbones, and a calm mouth expression. Her hair is styled with volume on top and seems to be pinned up. She is wearing a garment with soft folds and loose sleeves, a high neckline encircling her neck. There is no visible jewelry. The background is minimal with faint lines suggesting depth, with a signature in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Bannerträger (Standard Bearer)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a suit of armor standing upright. The armor has intricate details and the person has a mustache and short hair. They are looking to the side and holding a sword with both hands. The background is dark with draped fabric visible on the right side.

artworks.title: Knabe mit Hund (Boy with Dog)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts a person's upper body in a slightly angled pose to the right, with their head turned towards the viewer. The person's facial features are detailed with expressive eyes and a subtle mouth; their hair is mostly obscured by a hat with a soft brim. They are wearing a collared garment, possibly a jacket, and holding a small dog under their arm. The background is a textured, cross-hatched surface.

artworks.title: Knabe mit Badehose und Strohhut (Boy Wearing Bathing-Trunks and Straw Hat)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image displays a full-length sketch of a young boy standing upright. He is positioned front-facing with a slight angle to his body, one hand resting by his side, and the other on his hip. The boy's facial features include a small nose, slightly curved lips, and large eyes. He has a short haircut and wears a hat with a wide brim. He is depicted wearing minimal attire, just a pair of shorts and sandals on his feet. The background is filled with sketch-like outlines of cats in various poses, some sitting and others in a more curled-up position.

artworks.title: Liegender Weiblicher Akt.—Studie zu "Joseph und Potiphar" (Reclining Female Nude—Study for "Joseph and Potiphar's Wife")
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a nude woman in a reclining pose. She is leaning back with her head tilted slightly downward, left knee raised, right leg extended. Her arms are bent, hands relaxed. She has long hair, a focused gaze, and delicate facial features. The background is minimal, with a plain surface and subtle lines.

artworks.title: Joseph und Potiphars Weib II (Joseph and Potiphar's Wife II)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude figure of a person shown from head to knee, lying on what appears to be a flat surface. The person is in a reclined position with their back and head resting against the ground, one arm extended above them and the other across their abdomen. The facial features include a slightly turned head with a partial profile view, showing a subtle smile and long flowing hair cascading around the shoulders. The body appears relaxed, with legs slightly bent. The background is minimal and consists of faint lines suggesting fabric or bedding. The image includes a signature by Lovis Corinth at the bottom.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis (Self-Portrait)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an individual from the waist up, facing forward. The person's head is slightly tilted and turned to the side with a focused expression. The facial features, such as a nose and mustache, are intricately lined, and the hair is short. The person is wearing a light-colored jacket over a shirt with a collar and tie. They are holding an object in their hands, potentially a notebook or tablet, with a pencil or pen ready. The background is simple without detailed shading, emphasizing the subject. The image is monochrome, composed of detailed line work and etching techniques.

artworks.title: Zwei Männliche Studienköpfe—Selbstbildnisse (Sketch of Two Male Heads—Self-Portraits)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketched portrait of two individuals. The person in the foreground has a strong jawline, a mustache, and a receding hairline. The person behind has an elongated face with pronounced cheekbones and appears older due to wrinkles or age marks. Both individuals are shown from the upper body up, wearing loose-fitting collars. The sketch suggests that the person in the foreground is holding an object in their hand. The background is plain, focusing on the individuals' features.

artworks.title: Verschiedene Köpfe und Selbstbildnis (Assorted Heads and Self-Portrait)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring a series of portrait sketches showcasing the faces and upper bodies of various subjects. The central figures include an older woman with short hair, a young boy with tousled hair, a shaded man with a mustache, and an older woman with tied-up hair. Detailed facial features are emphasized through shading and line work. In the lower part, there is a girl with long hair and large eyes. The clothing is outlined simply, indicating basic garments such as shirts and blouses. The setting is abstract with no clear background elements, directing focus to the facial expressions of the individuals.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis—Kopf (Self-Portrait—Head)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man, depicted in an artistic, sketch-like style. The man is positioned slightly angled, with his head turned to the side, but his eyes are directed forward. His facial features are bold and pronounced, with a strong brow, deep-set eyes, and a thick mustache. His hair is short and appears closely cropped. The man is wearing a collared shirt, visible around his neck. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain. Below the portrait is a signature, "Lovis Corinth."

artworks.title: Modellstudie (Study of a Model)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a person facing away from the viewer with arms raised, seeming to adjust their hair. The person is nude and has medium-length textured hair. The background depicts a room with minimal details, including a draped piece of furniture and a simple wall with a window or door frame. The style of the image is sketch-like with visible pencil or ink strokes. No jewelry or objects are visible on the person.

artworks.title: Salome
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing the upper half of one person and the face and upper shoulders of another person. The person in the foreground appears to be leaning slightly forward with their head turned to the left, showing their profile. Their hair is styled up and adorned with decorations. They are wearing a top that reveals their shoulders and arms, with draped clothing. The person in the background is slightly obscured, with their facial features faintly visible, and wearing a wide-brimmed hat with feathers. The background is sparse, focusing on the figures themselves.

artworks.title: Männliches Bildnis mit Aufgestütztem Arm (Portrait of a Man Smoking)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sketched from the waist up. He is seated with his head resting against his right hand, which is propped on a surface in front of him. The man has a contemplative expression with raised eyebrows and deep-set eyes. He has short, dark hair, and is dressed in a buttoned shirt and a jacket. His left hand lightly rests on the surface near him. In front of him is a small stack of books or a box. The background is plain without any additional elements.

artworks.title: Der Künstler und der Tod II (The Artist and Death II)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper bodies of two figures: a man and a human skeleton. The man is situated next to the skeleton, on the right side of the image. The man has a serious expression, a mustache, short cropped hair, and is wearing a shirt with a collar. His arms are crossed in front of his torso. The skeleton, on the left side, has a visible skull and ribcage. In the background, there is an illustration of a skull with large horns mounted on the wall. The illustration has a sketch-like quality with visible lines and shading.
